description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Wind Chosen Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Wind Chosen Mode
description.text: Casts Onion Soul: Wind after using two of Synchrospell Wind or Breachspell Wind, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
